Calibrations.save_complete_paired_days_in_the_product: A calibration needs actual production for whole days.
Calibrations._this_is_a_provisional_assessment_based: Preliminary: based on fewer than 30 days.

status_messages.ready: This calibration met the accuracy criteria on the test days.
status_messages.rejected: Forecasts keep the calibration in use.
status_messages.insufficient: Calculate it again once more days have actual production.

reasons.insufficient_complete_days: Not enough whole days with actual production.
reasons.insufficient_training_support: The calibration days have too little production to calculate a factor.
reasons.zero_production_holdout: Days without production among the test days prevent a change of calibration.
reasons.baseline_improvement_below_margin: It did not reduce the error enough compared with forecasts without calibration.
reasons.factor_at_bound: The factor reached its allowed limit.
reasons.incumbent_mae_regression: It increased the error compared with the calibration in use then.
reasons.baseline_bias_regression: It increased the average difference compared with forecasts without calibration.
reasons.incumbent_bias_regression: It increased the average difference compared with the calibration in use then.

Calibrations.in_force_none: No calibration in use. Forecasts are made without calibration.
Calibrations.not_effective: Not applied: the data of its calibration days changed. Forecasts are made without calibration until another calibration is chosen.
Calibrations.activate_effect: Factor {factor} applies to new forecasts and to satellite data from {start}, its first calibration day. Forecasts already made keep their calibration.
Calibrations.activate_effect_undated: Factor {factor} applies to new forecasts. Forecasts already made stay as they are.
Calibrations.activation_turns_automation_on: Automatic calibration will be turned on.
Calibrations.reset_effect: New forecasts and satellite data are calculated without calibration (factor 1). Forecasts already made keep their calibration. Automatic calibration will be turned off.

blockers.configuration_changed: It was calculated with other technical details, or the plant has no current technical details.

blockers.incumbent_changed: The calibration in use changed after it was calculated.
blockers.calibration_not_activatable: Its calculation did not end with a result that can be used.

Calibrations.request_sent: The new calibration will appear in the list when its calculation starts.

Calibrations.days_incomplete: Calculate a new calibration for this period once its last day has ended in plant time.
Calibrations.await_configuration: Calculate a new calibration once the plant has current technical details.

reasons.calibration_not_activatable: The new calibration cannot be put into use.

ProductionImport.choose_a_csv_no_larger_than_2: Choose a CSV file of at most 2 MB.
ProductionImport.could_not_read_the_production_csv: This file could not be read. Choose a CSV file.
ProductionImport.use_a_csv_with_the_exact_header: Use a file downloaded under Actual production, in English or Turkish, or a file with the columns starts_at, ends_at, energy_mwh, quality and source. First split an hour whose half hours have different statuses into its half hours. Write energy in MWh, or in kWh in a column named {kwh}, and each time with its offset, such as +03:00. Times must not overlap, and a file holds at most 2,000 rows from at most 31 days in plant time.
ProductionImport.quality_valid_outage_curtailed_or_invali: In the {status} column write Normal, Outage, Production curtailed or Invalid value; in the {source} column, where the value comes from, in up to 200 characters. One unit applies to the whole file.
